subject.title: fix(tool-call-repair): parse JSON-format plain-text tool calls alongside bracket/XML/Harmony

question: Should the public shared provider fallback promote standalone JSON assistant text into executable tool calls, or should JSON remain diagnostic text while Ollama users are directed to native /api/chat handling?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible but intentionally changes executable fallback policy for multiple provider plugins, so repository policy cannot determine the permanent compatibility boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Allow narrow JSON promotion
options.body: Accept the shared fallback after exact-path real-provider proof confirms one promotion, no raw leakage, and ordinary JSON preservation.

options.title: Keep JSON diagnostic-only
options.body: Do not merge the shared promotion and focus the linked Ollama report on native response normalization or correct native-provider configuration.

options.title: Require provider-owned opt-in
options.body: Pause until a provider/plugin contract can enable JSON text repair selectively instead of changing the shared default.

recommendation.title: Allow narrow JSON promotion
recommendation.body: Accept the shared fallback after exact-path real-provider proof confirms one promotion, no raw leakage, and ordinary JSON preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent provider-runtime and plugin-SDK policy history best matches the cross-provider compatibility decision.
